aboutText: Electract Electrical Contracting has been serving the Fairfield community with exceptional electrical services for years. Our team, led by Leigh, brings expertise in both residential and commercial projects, from lighting installations to complete rewiring. We are known for our responsiveness, professionalism, and attention to detail, as reflected in our customer reviews. Based in Fairfield, we are committed to providing reliable and high-quality electrical solutions across Melbourne.
servicesText: From new builds to renovations, Electract offers a wide range of electrical services tailored to your needs. We handle everything from safety switch installations to data cabling, ensuring your property is safe and efficient. Our team in Fairfield is equipped to tackle any electrical challenge with precision and care.
